_meta.title: HyperEdit Video Combine
_meta.description: Load frame sequence directory + audio file → VHS_VideoCombine → export final video. Used by the ASSEMBLER agent to combine graded frame sequences with the audio mix into a picture-locked output.
_meta.note: Light workload — run on local Mac :8188.

template_vars.FRAMES_DIRECTORY: Absolute path to directory containing PNG frame sequence (e.g. /tmp/project_abc/frames/)
template_vars.AUDIO_PATH: Absolute path to audio file (WAV or MP3, e.g. /tmp/project_abc/30_radio_edit.wav)
template_vars.OUTPUT_PREFIX: Filename prefix for exported video (e.g. project_abc_picture_lock)
